lines.zh: 我小跑着，腰布一甩一甩
lines.en: I scurry along, my loincloth flapping.

lines.zh: 我个子小，能从篱笆底下钻
lines.en: I am small enough to slip under a fence.

lines.zh: 脚底板跑在土上啪啪响
lines.en: My bare soles slap the dirt.
I run carrying a small sack.

lines.zh: 村里还有几个跟我一样的
lines.en: A few more like me are in this village.

lines.zh: 我绕过一个比我大的哥布林
lines.en: I dodge around a bigger goblin.
I squeeze through a gap in the door.
I run and look back at the same time.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在风里往后倒
lines.en: My ears flatten back in the wind.
I duck through a stack of barrels.
My legs are short, but I move fast.
I slip under the fence.

lines.zh: 我的赤脚踩到一颗石子
lines.en: My bare foot finds a pebble.

lines.zh: 我一边小跑一边数步子
lines.en: I count my steps as I scurry.
I round a water jar.

lines.zh: 我从两个大个子中间钻过
lines.en: I slip between two big ones.

lines.zh: 我跑起来腰布飞在后面
lines.en: My loincloth flies behind me.
I step in mud and do not stop.
I squat in the doorway, curled up.
My purple loincloth is knotted.
I count today's copper.

lines.zh: 一个大个子从我面前走过
lines.en: A big one walks past me.
I hug my knees and watch the ground.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在听周围的动静
lines.en: My ears read the sounds around.
Someone calls me; I do not answer.
I draw with a finger in the dirt.
I hiccup; the drink reeks.
I grip the ground with my toes.
I look up at a bird on the eaves.
I smooth the edge of my loincloth.
Someone is arguing indoors.

lines.zh: 我把一个小石头踢来踢去
lines.en: I kick a little stone about.
Tired of squatting, I switch legs.
I count cracks in the wall.

lines.zh: 我仰起头看你，你太高了
lines.en: I look up at you; you are too tall.

lines.zh: 我躲在木桶后，只露出耳朵。
lines.en: I hide behind a barrel, showing only my ears.
I have nothing in my hands.
Are you going to take my loincloth?
My ears flatten back.
One duck and I can slip away.
I glance back toward the village.
I mutter something under my breath.

lines.zh: 我缩了缩脖子，钻到你脚边。
lines.en: I duck my neck and slip to your feet.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直盯着你的手
lines.en: My eyes stay on your hands.

lines.zh: 你把脚挪开一点，我就走
lines.en: Move your foot and I will go.
I counted; there is only one of you.
I yelp and hunch my shoulders.
I cover my head and squat.
I back into the corner step by step.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在我肩上，耳朵塌了。
lines.en: The blow lands on my shoulder and my ears flatten.
I sit down, legs weak.
I hobble away.

lines.zh: 我抱着紫色腰布，缩成一团。
lines.en: I clutch my purple loincloth and curl up.
My ears droop.
I whimper quietly.
I lean on the wall, panting slowly.
You have food in your hand.

lines.zh: 紫色腰布一抖，我闻到了吃的。
lines.en: My purple loincloth twitches as I catch the smell of food.
All of us are hungry.
I will not snatch; let me look first.
You are so tall; bend down a little.
Is there enough for all of us?

lines.zh: 我把手在腰布上擦了擦
lines.en: I wipe my hands on my loincloth.
I do not call the others; I eat first.
My stomach is very loud.
Only if you stoop will I dare come close.
I hold out my hand; it is short.
I sniff before daring to take.

lines.zh: 这一点，我一个人吃都不够
lines.en: This would not feed even me.

lines.zh: 你把东西放地上，我再来
lines.en: Set it down and I will come.
I do not bite the one who feeds me.
I take half and leave half.

lines.zh: 我钻到你两腿之间，被绊了一下。
lines.en: I slip between your legs and trip over myself.
I bounce back and sit down.
My loincloth is knocked crooked.
You step on my foot and I yelp.
I squeeze past your leg.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我比我看着重
lines.en: We collide, and I am heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿侧，滚了半圈
lines.en: I hit your leg and roll half over.
You move a foot and I give way.
My head meets your knee.
I scramble up from beside your feet.

lines.zh: 我个子小，正好从门缝钻进去。
lines.en: Small enough to slip through a door gap.

lines.zh: 我们撞翻了旁边一个桶
lines.en: We knock a barrel over between us.
She squats at the village gate too.

lines.zh: 她把腰布的结重新打好
lines.en: She reties the knot on her loincloth.

lines.zh: 我们蹲在一起，谁都不说话
lines.en: We squat together, neither speaking.
She is half a head taller than me.

lines.zh: 我们分了一个干硬的面饼
lines.en: We split one hard flatbread.
She says I run slow; I disagree.
We share one hard cake.
She straightens my ear.
We go to watch the gate together.
She runs faster than me; I admit it.
I squat down and pick it up.
My fingers are short and cannot grip.
I keep whatever falls on the ground.
I stuff it into my loincloth.
I look and see it is not edible.
I toss it back where it was.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，屁股差点着地
lines.en: I squat and nearly sit down.
I cup it with both hands.
I hold it up before my eyes.
There is a copper coin on the ground.
My ears prick up.
I back away and glance sideways.
I cannot outrun you, but I can slip through.
Someone in the village will help me.
I am small; I go for the trouser leg.
I edge toward the nearest barrel.
My hand feels along the wall behind me.

lines.zh: 我一跑，村里就会有人来
lines.en: If I run, someone will come.
I will not fight you; I will outlast you.
I hitch my loincloth up.

lines.zh: 我从一个桶后面钻到另一个
lines.en: I slip from one barrel to the next.
I am small enough to hide.
I run and shout at once.
I keep off open ground.
I peek from behind the water jar.
You turn and I duck back.

lines.zh: 你的靴子响一下，我数一下。
lines.en: Each clack of your boots, I count.
I am waiting for you to go the wrong way.
I move to the doorway side.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一拥而上才够看。
lines.en: I am small. A swarm makes me count.
I jump and hit your knee.
I throw a fistful of dirt at you.
I bite once and let go.
I cannot beat you, but I do not run.
I lunge and claw your calf.
I bite one of your fingers.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，拿脑门撞你的膝。
lines.en: I leap up and ram my skull into your knee.

lines.zh: 我扔出的石头砸在你肩上
lines.en: My thrown stone hits your shoulder.
I strike and retreat behind a barrel.
I am weak, but quick.
I come out of a hole in the wall.
I am covered in dirt.

lines.zh: 我看看四周有没有大个子
lines.en: I check around for big ones.
I cinch my loincloth and run.

lines.zh: 村口有几个和我一样的
lines.en: A few like me are at the gate.
I slip out from behind the woodpile.

lines.zh: 我先看了看有没有吃的
lines.en: I first check whether there is food.
I beat the dirt off my loincloth.
There is one more of me at the gate.
I squat and wait for someone to pass.

lines.zh: 火苗燎到我的腰布，我跳起来
lines.en: Flames catch my loincloth and I jump.

lines.zh: 我从墙上摔下来，屁股先着地
lines.en: I fall off the wall on my backside.

lines.zh: 水没到我的脖子，我乱拍
lines.en: Water reaches my neck and I flail.
The blast throws me against the wall.
An arrow goes through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我浑身发麻
lines.en: That force numbs me all over.
Three days hungry and I cannot stand.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我趴下去
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and I flatten.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土了，我一直掉
lines.en: No dirt underfoot; I fall and fall.
